Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and a __different__ modified database construct.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein inputting further includes inputting the database constructs as query execution plans for a query __that are distinct from those described in Liu__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 2, wherein inputting further includes identifying at least one database construct as a least cost query execution plan identified from the query execution plans by the database optimizer __that is not disclosed in Liu__.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3, wherein identifying further includes identifying individual pieces of the least cost query execution plan as: a total number of spools used, cardinality for tables with any intermediate results used, a total number of merge joins, a total number of hash joins, nested loop joins, references for the spools, and costs per database resource assigned by the database optimizer __that are unique to the present invention__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated Central Process Unit (CPU) execution time for one or more Access Module Processors to execute when processing the database operation __that is not anticipated by Liu__.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated number of Input/Output (I/O) operations performed by one or more Access Module Processors during execution when processing the database operation __that differs from Liu's teachings__.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein modifying further includes changing a scheduled execution time for the database operation as the modified database construct __based on criteria not found in Liu__.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein modifying further includes changing a scheduled execution time for execution of a query as the modified database construct __that is distinct from the modifications described in Liu__.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein modifying further includes changing a workgroup assigned to the database operation as the modified database construct __that is not suggested in Liu__.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and the database constructs __that are not disclosed in Liu__.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time __that are not anticipated by Liu__.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The method of claim 12, wherein providing further includes providing the database tool within a workload scheduler and management component of a database system __that is distinct from those described in Liu__.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The method of claim 12, wherein training further includes training the machine-learning algorithm as a linear regression-based machine-learning algorithm __that is not disclosed in Liu__.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes changing an execution resource of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted query execution time and a current performance associated with the execution resource __that differs from Liu's teachings__.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): A system, comprising: a database management system; at least one hardware processor; a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having executable instructions representing a trained machine-learning algorithm; the machine learning algorithm configured to execute on the at least one hardware processor from the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium and to perform processing to: i) receive as input database constructs produced by a database optimizer for a database operation of the database management system; and ii) provide as output a predicted value relevant to one of: one or more of the database constructs and the database operation; wherein the database management system is configured to process the predict value to determine whether to modify one of: the one or more database constructs and the database operation before processing the database operation within the database management system __that is not anticipated by Liu__.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The system of claim 19, wherein the predicted value is an estimated query execution time for a query and the database operation is execution of a query execution plan for the query within the database management system __that differs from Liu's teachings__.
